paragraphs: Ravya bar Kisi. R’ Yirmeyah of Difti told Ravina that the disagreement concerned the scapegoat. Ravya bar Kisi died that day. They gave a mnemonic, “Ravya bar Kisi atones like the scapegoat” (Yoma 42a). In Heilprin’s mnemonic the name is written דביא. Hullin 20b: Ravina said, ‘Ravin bar Kisi told me.’ Bava Batra 63a: Ravina bar Kisi.
